author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
A Tested member video preview! Adam tasked long-time friend of Tested Bill Doran of @punishedprops to design a 3D printable eye mechanism for one of the many scans of his head that adorn his cave. And while Bill did a fantastic job with his execution, Adam couldn't help but want something a little more robust. In this deleted scene, formerly exclusive to our Tested Premium and Patron members, Adam makes a nearly 1:1 replica of Bill's CAD drawn handle from aluminum on the lathe.
